account.title: Account Settings
account.signedOut: Sign in to manage your account and workspaces.

accentColor.title: Account color
accentColor.saveFailed: Could not save your color. Try again.

members.description: Invite people to your workspace and manage their roles. Only workspace admins and owners can change roles or remove members.

offline.description: Pages kept on this device open without a connection. Pages you make available offline stay until you remove them; the last pages you opened are kept too.
offline.webOnly: This browser cannot keep pages offline.
offline.empty: No pages are kept on this device yet.
offline.removeAllDescription: Every page kept on this device is removed. Changes not yet sent are kept and sent when the connection is back.

workspace.avatarDescription: Shown beside the workspace name to every member.
workspace.adminOnly: Only workspace admins and owners can change these settings.
workspace.nameInvalid: A workspace name needs 1 to %{max} characters.
workspace.deleteDescription: Every member loses access to this workspace and its pages and databases.
workspace.resetDescription: Deletes every page, database and note in your personal workspace for good. The workspace stays, empty.
workspace.resetPrompt: Everything in it is deleted for good and cannot be recovered. Type %{name} to confirm.
workspace.resetMismatch: The name you typed does not match. Nothing was deleted.
workspace.exportDescription: Every page you can open, as Markdown or HTML files in folders by subpage, with databases as tables.
workspace.exportFailed: The workspace could not be exported.
